site.name: Squishy
site.tagline: Free file compression tools that run entirely in your browser.

quality.label: Compression level
quality.disabledByTarget: Disabled — a target size is set below, so it controls compression instead.

targetSize.label: Target size (optional)
targetSize.hint: If set, this overrides the compression level above.

progress.label: Squishing...
progress.loadingEngine: Downloading the compressor for this format (one time only — it's cached after this)...
progress.pass: Fine-tuning to hit your target size (pass {n})...

result.targetMissed: Couldn't get under {target} MB — this is as small as it goes without destroying the video.

tool.privacyNote: Keep this tab open and active while it processes — for the fastest speed.

warnings.target_above_source: Your video is already smaller than that target, so there's nothing to squish.
warnings.quality_will_be_poor: That target is very tight for a video this long — expect a blurry result.
warnings.resolution_reduced: Resolution lowered to {width}×{height} so the picture stays clean at this size.
warnings.framerate_reduced: Frame rate lowered to {fps} fps to keep more detail in each frame.
warnings.audio_removed: Audio removed — there wasn't enough room in the target size for a sound track.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while compressing. Try a different file or reload the page.
errors.noVideo: That file doesn't seem to contain a video track.

tool.targetPreview: Your video is {size} — that target is larger, so nothing will be compressed.

meta.title: SquishyFile — Free Video Compressor, Right in Your Browser
meta.description: Free online video compressor for MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI and WebM — no uploads, no file-size limit, no watermark, no sign up. Runs entirely in your browser.

hero.title: Squish your videos, keep the quality
hero.subtitle: 100% free video compression with no file-size limit and no watermark on export. Everything runs right in your browser — no uploads, no waiting on a server.

meta.title: Compress Video to 10MB, 25MB or Any Size — SquishyFile
meta.description: Shrink your video to an exact size — 10MB, 25MB or any target — for email, Discord, WhatsApp and Instagram limits. Free and private, right in your browser.

hero.title: Compress your video to an exact file size
hero.subtitle: Type in a target size in MB and SquishyFile does the math — perfect for email attachments, Discord uploads, or any platform with a strict size limit. 100% free, right in your browser.

meta.title: Compress Video on iPhone in Safari — No App Needed
meta.description: Compress video on your iPhone right in Safari — no app to install. Pick a video from Photos and shrink it down for free; nothing ever leaves your phone.

hero.title: Compress video on iPhone, right in Safari
hero.subtitle: No app to install — just open this page in Safari, pick a video from your Photos library, and squish it down to size. Everything happens on your iPhone, nothing is uploaded.
